en_html: The President would not give an appreciation of the new system proposed by M. de Lapradelle until its author had explained it. At first sight this system appeared to be tremendous backsliding from the ideas upon which it seemed that the members of the Committee were agreed, and to tend most regrettably to give full sway to the absolutist political ideas of governments, in the administration of international justice.
